Our partner, a major organisation active in the services sector, is looking for an experienced Tech Lead .NET to strengthen its development team.

Our partner is a well-established Belgian organisation operating in a complex and evolving environment.

With digital transformation at the heart of its strategy, the company is investing in modern technologies and developing innovative software solutions to support its activities and improve its services.

You will join a technical team working on strategic projects in an environment that values innovation, collaboration and technical excellence.
Tech Lead .NET | The Role :
As a Tech Lead .NET, you will combine hands-on development with technical leadership. You will contribute to the evolution of a business platform built on .NET and Microsoft Azure, while guiding developers and ensuring high technical standards.

Your responsibilities will include :

• Developing and maintaining enterprise applications using .NET, C# and Azure.
• Defining technical solutions and translating business requirements into technical specifications.
• Leading code reviews, ensuring code quality and maintaining software architecture standards.
• Coaching developers and providing technical guidance.
• Working with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code and GitHub Copilot to accelerate development while validating generated code.

• Knowledge of DDD, Event Sourcing, GraphQL, PostgreSQL or RabbitMQ is a plus.
• Fluent in Dutch, French and English.

Three boxes to tick: product ownership, partner-driven platforms, and modernising a legacy core without breaking the service.

Product Owner – Registration & Domain Lifecycle | Brussels

Our client is a European, technology-driven organisation that operates a registration platform its partners rely on every single day.

Its product is a lifecycle: a name is registered, renewed, transferred, suspended or released, millions of times over, through a network of accredited partners and under rules it does not set alone.

That platform is now being modernised, moving from a legacy core towards the next generation of registration services, without a single interruption to the service partners depend on.

To drive this, the organisation is looking for a Product Owner to own the vision, the roadmap and the backlog of this platform.

 

The job

• Own the vision, roadmap and backlog of the registration platform and of the lifecycle capabilities built on top of it.
• Translate partner needs, operational realities and regulatory obligations into clear product direction, and make transparent trade-offs between value, urgency, risk and delivery capacity.
 
Role
• Define and maintain the roadmap across the core registration platform, registration APIs, domain-name lifecycle and data analytics capabilities.
• Own and structure the backlog, balancing immediate service improvements against modernisation, resilience and long-term sustainability.
• Give clear product direction to the Business Analysts, validate functional requirements and acceptance criteria, and own functional acceptance through to go/no-go release decisions.
• Work closely with Business Owners and with the engineering, architecture, service delivery, compliance and security teams to keep requirements understood, feasible and aligned.
• Track adoption, usability and service quality, and turn what the numbers show into roadmap decisions.
Profile
• 7+ years in technology-driven products or services, with real ownership as a Product Owner or Product Manager.
• Domain-name ecosystem knowledge (EPP, WHOIS/RDAP, DNS) is a big plus; experience on regulated, partner-driven platforms — telecom, payments, utilities — works just as well.
• You know how to modernise a legacy core without disrupting daily service.
• Excellent written and spoken English.

jobs.occupation: Lead Contract Engineer Nuclear Pressure Equipment (M/F/X)

As a Lead Contract Engineer (M/F/X) in the Nuclear Pressure Equipment Team, you will join a dynamic team that works every day for our customers and, in doing so, helps create a safer and more efficient society. Vinçotte is active with various types of customers. We have developed our expertise and organization in both public and residential buildings, and we are highly entrepreneurial in the energy sector, including nuclear activities. In addition, we are highly innovative for customers in the (petro)chemical and pharmaceutical sectors, production environments, and the transport and logistics sector. With unparalleled expertise and boundless passion, we are committed to a safer society. With more than 60,000 satisfied customers, we demonstrate that the combination of our expertise, guidance, and technology makes all the difference. Vinçotte is part of Kiwa, which is itself a member of the SHV Family of Companies, and continues its commitment to innovation to deliver ever greater safety and efficiency.
 

As a 
Lead Contract Engineer (M/F/X), you will be the point of contact for our customers. You build a relationship of trust with the customer and provide tailored advice for the assessment of the construction/design of nuclear pressure equipment according to various construction codes and standards. You maintain regular contact with your customers and also carry out inspections yourself. You are responsible for following up projects from A to Z, from quotation and design through to actual execution and invoicing. In addition, you are also the point of contact for the inspectors on site.
 

You can always rely on your colleagues: driven experts who are happy to help you further.
 

Vinçotte also supports you in deepening and broadening your expertise. We start this on your very first day, as you will first receive thorough training and an internship before working independently.

 

• Degree: You have a Master’s degree in Industrial Sciences – Electromechanics. A Welding Engineer degree is a strong asset. 

• Experience: You preferably have around five years of experience in the maintenance/inspection of pressure equipment. 

• Skills: 
 

• You are eager to learn and keep up to date with trends and developments in your field. 

• You have a sense of quality and an eye for detail. 

• You show initiative and enjoy customer contact. 

• You work independently and in a disciplined manner. 

• You speak fluent Dutch or French and have a good knowledge of English (both written and spoken). 

• You are communicative and entrepreneurial, with a sense of initiative and organization.

jobs.occupation: Reach Truck Driver - Logent (Evergem / region Ghent, Belgium)
jobs.description:
